+ "use client";
+ 
+ import { useRef } from "react";
+ import { motion, useInView } from "framer-motion";
+ import { cn } from "@/utils/utils";
+ 
+ interface AnimatedUnderlineProps {
+   children: React.ReactNode;
+   className?: string;
+   delay?: number;
+   duration?: number;
+   once?: boolean;
+ }
+ 
+ export function AnimatedUnderline({
+   children,
+   className,
+   delay = 0,
+   duration = 0.8,
+   once = true,
+ }: AnimatedUnderlineProps) {
+   const ref = useRef(null);
+   const isInView = useInView(ref, { once, margin: "-100px" });
+ 
+   return (
+     <span ref={ref} className={cn("relative inline-block", className)}>
+       {children}
+       <motion.span
+         className="bg-primary absolute bottom-0 left-0 h-[2px] w-full origin-left"
+         initial={{ scaleX: 0 }}
+         animate={{ scaleX: isInView ? 1 : 0 }}
+         transition={{
+           duration,
+           delay,
+           ease: [0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94], // Custom easing for smooth animation
+         }}
+       />
+     </span>
+   );
+ }
+ 
```

```diff
- 
+ # AnimatedUnderline Component
+ 
+ ## Overview
+ 
+ The `AnimatedUnderline` component provides a smooth underline animation that triggers when the element comes into view. It's built using Framer Motion's `useInView` hook for intersection observer functionality.
+ 
+ ## Architecture
+ 
+ ### Key Features
+ - **Intersection Observer**: Uses Framer Motion's `useInView` to detect when element enters viewport
+ - **Customizable Animation**: Configurable delay, duration, and easing
+ - **One-time or Repeatable**: Can animate once or every time element enters view
+ - **Responsive**: Works across all screen sizes
+ 
+ ### Component Structure
+ ```typescript
+ interface AnimatedUnderlineProps {
+   children: React.ReactNode;
+   className?: string;
+   delay?: number;      // Animation delay in seconds (default: 0)
+   duration?: number;   // Animation duration in seconds (default: 0.8)
+   once?: boolean;      // Animate only once (default: true)
+ }
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Usage Examples
+ 
+ ### Basic Usage
+ ```tsx
+ <AnimatedUnderline>
+   <span>This text will be underlined when scrolled into view</span>
+ </AnimatedUnderline>
+ ```
+ 
+ ### With Custom Timing
+ ```tsx
+ <AnimatedUnderline delay={0.5} duration={1.2}>
+   <h2>Delayed animation with slower duration</h2>
+ </AnimatedUnderline>
+ ```
+ 
+ ### Repeating Animation
+ ```tsx
+ <AnimatedUnderline once={false}>
+   <span>This underlines every time it enters the viewport</span>
+ </AnimatedUnderline>
+ ```
+ 
+ ### With Custom Styling
+ ```tsx
+ <AnimatedUnderline className="text-2xl font-bold">
+   <span>Styled text with animated underline</span>
+ </AnimatedUnderline>
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Implementation Details
+ 
+ 1. **Viewport Detection**: The component uses a margin of `-100px` for the intersection observer, meaning the animation triggers when the element is within 100px of entering the viewport
+ 
+ 2. **Animation Curve**: Uses a custom easing function `[0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94]` for a smooth, natural animation
+ 
+ 3. **Transform Origin**: The underline scales from left to right using `origin-left` and `scaleX`
+ 
+ 4. **Styling**: The underline uses the theme's primary color and is 2px in height
+ 
+ ## Customization
+ 
+ To modify the underline appearance, you can:
+ 
+ 1. **Change Color**: Update the `bg-primary` class to any other color
+ 2. **Change Height**: Modify the `h-[2px]` class
+ 3. **Change Position**: Adjust the `bottom-0` class for different vertical positioning
+ 4. **Add Effects**: Add shadow, gradient, or other CSS effects to the motion.span
+ 
+ ## Performance Considerations
+ 
+ - The component uses `once={true}` by default to prevent unnecessary re-renders
+ - Intersection Observer is efficiently handled by Framer Motion
+ - The animation uses GPU-accelerated transforms for smooth performance
+ 
+ ## Accessibility
+ 
+ The underline is purely decorative and doesn't affect screen reader output or keyboard navigation. The semantic meaning is preserved in the children content.

---

```diff
- 
+ # AnimatedUnderline Component - Pseudocode
+ 
+ ## Component Logic Flow
+ 
+ ```
+ COMPONENT AnimatedUnderline(children, className, delay, duration, once):
+     // Initialize component state
+     CREATE ref = useRef(null)
+     
+     // Set up intersection observer
+     SET isInView = useInView(ref, {
+         once: once (default: true),
+         margin: "-100px"  // Trigger 100px before element enters viewport
+     })
+     
+     // Render structure
+     RETURN:
+         <span ref={ref} className={relative + className}>
+             {children}
+             
+             <motion.span className={underline-styles}>
+                 ANIMATION_PROPS:
+                     initial: { scaleX: 0 }  // Start with no underline
+                     animate: { 
+                         scaleX: isInView ? 1 : 0  // Scale to full width when in view
+                     }
+                     transition: {
+                         duration: duration (default: 0.8s),
+                         delay: delay (default: 0s),
+                         ease: [0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94]  // Custom easing curve
+                     }
+             </motion.span>
+         </span>
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Animation Sequence
+ 
+ ```
+ 1. INITIAL STATE:
+    - Underline is scaled to 0 (invisible)
+    - Component is watching for viewport entry
+ 
+ 2. VIEWPORT DETECTION:
+    - When element is within (viewport - 100px):
+      - Set isInView = true
+      - Trigger animation
+ 
+ 3. ANIMATION EXECUTION:
+    - Wait for delay (if specified)
+    - Scale underline from 0 to 1 over duration
+    - Use easing curve for smooth animation
+    - Transform originates from left side
+ 
+ 4. COMPLETION:
+    - If once=true: Animation stays at scaleX=1
+    - If once=false: Reset when out of view, repeat on re-entry
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Integration Example
+ 
+ ```
+ // In Hero component
+ IMPORT AnimatedUnderline from "@/components/ui/animated-underline"
+ 
+ RENDER:
+     <AnimatedUnderline 
+         delay={0.5}      // Start 0.5s after in view
+         duration={1.2}   // Take 1.2s to complete
+     >
+         <TrueFocus 
+             sentence="The Competition Just Became Your Lead Gen"
+             activeIndices={[0, 1, 3, 3, 6]}
+         />
+     </AnimatedUnderline>
+ ```
+ 
+ ## Key Implementation Details
+ 
+ ```
+ INTERSECTION_OBSERVER_CONFIG:
+     - Margin: -100px (triggers before fully in viewport)
+     - Once: true (default, prevents re-triggering)
+     - Root: null (uses viewport as root)
+ 
+ ANIMATION_CONFIG:
+     - Transform: scaleX (horizontal scaling)
+     - Origin: left (grows from left to right)
+     - Easing: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94)
+     - GPU-accelerated for performance
+ 
+ STYLING:
+     - Height: 2px
+     - Color: theme primary color
+     - Position: absolute bottom
+     - Width: 100% of parent
+ ``` 
```
